content.text: New York Yankees left fielder Cody Bellinger (35) smiles and high-fives teammates in the dugout after he scored on Giancarlo Stanton's single and Rosario made a three-run home run during the eighth inning of a baseball game against the Athletics, Tuesday, April 7, 2026, in New York. (AP Photo/Angelina Katsanis)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.The New York Yankees face the Tampa Bay Rays on Saturday, April 11, 2026 at Tropicana Field in St. Petersburg, Fla. Fans can watch the game live on YES Network at 6:10 p.m. ET for free with a trial to DirecTV or FuboTV. The game will also be available to stream for out-of-market fans on MLB.TV.
